title: Controllable Affective Generation via Latent Vector Steering
abstract: arXiv:2608.25569v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often produce emotionally flattened responses after alignment, limiting their effectiveness in affect-sensitive applications. In this paper, we propose EmoVec, a lightweight framework for controllable affective generation via latent vector steering. EmoVec extracts emotion-specific directions from paired neutral and emotion-conditioned responses using contrastive activation addition, and further refines them through task-specific debiasing and principal subspace removal. During inference, these vectors are injected into the final residual stream with static or scenario-adaptive scaling, enabling continuous control over emotional intensity without updating model weights. Experiments across three LLMs and eight emotions show that EmoVec consistently improves emotional salience while largely preserving semantic content, fluency, and coherence. translated_title: 通过潜在向量引导的可控情感生成
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在对齐后常常产生情感扁平化的响应，限制了它们在情感敏感应用中的有效性。本文提出了EmoVec，一种通过潜在向量引导实现可控情感生成的轻量级框架。EmoVec使用对比激活加法从配对的中性响应和情感条件响应中提取情感特定方向，并通过任务特定去偏和主子空间去除进一步细化这些方向。在推理过程中，这些向量以静态或场景自适应缩放注入最终残差流，实现对情感强度的连续控制，而无需更新模型权重。在三个LLM和八种情感上的实验表明，EmoVec持续改善情感显著性，同时基本保持语义内容、流畅性和连贯性。消融研究和人工评估进一步证实了其有效性。
tldr: 提出EmoVec框架，通过对比激活提取情感方向并注入残差流，无需权重更新即可实现LLM的可控情感生成，兼顾情感强度与语义保真。
en_tdlr: EmoVec enables controllable affective generation in LLMs by extracting emotion directions via contrastive activation and injecting them into the residual stream, achieving continuous emotional intensity control without weight updates.
